{{Top|leg}}
A '''plasma conduit''' was a channel for moving superheated plasma.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> They were a key part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] power supply,<ref name="TCW:BH">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref> as well as a component of [[Factory/Legends|manufacturing facilities]], [[Power plant/Legends|power plants]], or anywhere that [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] was utilized. These conduits were constructed of very strong materials in order to withstand the heat of plasma, and ruptures were rare, though they could be intentionally ruptured by individuals looking to use the dangerous situation to their advantage, typically by shooting the conduit.<ref name="TUR" />
